title: Python DAO origin validator accepts noncanonical same-IID source aliases
description: DaoOriginValidator.validate() looks up the pinned key by source IID and checks only _pubkey_to_iid(pubkey) == source[8:16]. A signed DAO using fe80::/64 or another prefix with the same IID therefore passes key binding, contrary to the canonical 02xx source contract now enforced by dao_origin_signature vectors and Rust. Require source_address == yggdrasil_address(pubkey) before signature/replay/route mutation, retain IID_MISMATCH as the fail-closed reason, and add exact link-local/cross-prefix negative tests plus vector-to-production coverage.
